customer: Got an offer on my pickup but I'm still shopping for something bigger to replace it. How long do I have before the offer runs out?
agent: Your offer is valid for 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, and you can find the exact expiration date on your offer page and in your confirmation email. We'll honor the offer as long as your appraisal appointment is on or before that expiration date, though rescheduling the appointment doesn't extend it. If it does expire while you're shopping, you can request a new offer at any time, and the new amount will reflect current market prices, so it may be higher or lower.
